cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Create the client config file
sftp = client.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/opt/areloria/game-data/world/client-config.json', 'w') as f:
    f.write('{"supabaseUrl": null, "supabaseAnonKey": null}')
sftp.close()
print("Created client-config.json")
# Also add /client-config.json route to nginx
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's|location /world {|location /client-config.json {\\n        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;\\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\\n    }\\n\\n    location /world {|' /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian.de")
# Reload nginx
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("nginx -s reload 2>&1")
print("Reloaded nginx")
client.close()
EOF
Created client-config.json
Reloaded nginx
